durations.clock: host monotonic seconds for journals; raw MOS counts separately
scope_notes: Setup starts at route-command issue and excludes earlier host checks.
RUN-to-Legacy includes injection, fixture ROM check/setup, timed operations, all debug dumps, five-second clean wait and completion observation.
Listener-to-cursor includes start, retrieval, unchanged-startup read and acknowledged EXIT; not pure link time.
Fixture run_ticks covers its setup/measurements/dumps before CSV saving; nominal 120 MOS counts/s, no independent oscillator calibration.
Scope gaps and total-host overhead are retained, not silently allocated or subtracted.

limits: No reverse bulk-rate, useful CPU headroom, autonomous send, rendering/HDMI completion or production qualification claim.
Nominal 72000 PRT1 counts/s, 13.8889 us/count; no independent oscillator calibration.
Software final-byte observations include interrupt/observation overhead; exact offsets retained.
Passive Pi collector was simplified after repeated short USB acquisitions; firmware/fixture/timing workload unchanged.
Original acquisition failures remain failures even where other samples or labelled runs supply selected byte proof.
